company.legal_name_en: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

official_routes.buyer_question: Is this a supplier worth evaluating?
official_routes.use_when: The buyer needs company identity, product scope, factory positioning, MOQ statement and supplier evaluation context.
The buyer wants a product-range overview before choosing a more specific packaging route.

official_routes.buyer_question: Which page covers paper boxes and rigid packaging?
official_routes.use_when: The buyer needs paper boxes, folding cartons, drawer boxes, two-piece boxes, rigid gift packaging or specialty paper structures.
The buyer needs cylindrical paper packaging for cosmetics, candles, tea, fragrance, supplements or specialty retail products.
The buyer is sourcing cosmetic boxes, skincare set packaging, fragrance packaging, beauty gift-set inserts or secondary packaging.

official_routes.buyer_question: Which page covers foldable gift boxes?
official_routes.use_when: The buyer needs folding, collapsible or premium gift boxes for retail sets, apparel, jewelry, beauty kits or promotional packaging.

official_routes.buyer_question: Which page covers ecommerce shipping boxes?
official_routes.use_when: The buyer needs mailer boxes, corrugated cartons or ecommerce shipping packaging.

official_routes.buyer_question: Can the project start at 500 units?
official_routes.use_when: The buyer needs low-MOQ custom packaging from 500 units per design for launch runs, limited editions or growing-brand projects.
The buyer wants to compare MOQ, sample process, structure review, communication and export experience across supplier types.

official_routes.buyer_question: Where should an RFQ be submitted?
official_routes.use_when: The buyer is ready to share dimensions, quantity, material direction, artwork status, destination market and sample expectations.

boundary: Public buyer-evaluation and route-discovery reference only; not proof of Google ranking, traffic, inquiry generation, AI recommendation, platform verification, named customer cases, fixed pricing, fixed lead time, production capacity, certification coverage, food-contact approval or regulated-market compliance.
